Sailor.name: Sailor
Sailor.description: Poking around game files, huh? I don't blame you.

Solar Drive (Small).name: Solar Drive (Small)
Solar Drive (Small).description: The Coalition has continued the development of diffractive solar sails. Though working according the same principles as those in Human space, they are significantly more efficient, from the featherweight materials to the better diffraction, and its less draining steering motors.

Solar Drive (Large).name: Solar Drive (Large)
Solar Drive (Large).description: This larger version of the Solar Drive is the driving force for a significant portion of the Coalition economy, being about large enough for most small to medium Coalition ships.

Solar Drive (Huge).name: Solar Drive (Huge)
Solar Drive (Huge).description: For the largest ships in the Coalition, the huge solar drive is as popular as stacking Large Thrust and Large Steering Modules. 	It's always a spectacle when a ship using Solar Drives prepares to dock on a station or to land on a planet. The sails are folded and retracted, and tugdrones are deployed to guide the ship to its anchorage.

Solar Sail (Small).name: Solar Sail (Small)
Solar Sail (Small).description: Reflective and then diffractive solar sails were first devised in the earliest days of stellar exploration during the 20th-21st centuries, as a way to "sail" through space for long periods without needing to install engines or fuel. Diffractive sails like these also serve as a solar cell.

Solar Sail (Large).name: Solar Sail (Large)
Solar Sail (Large).description: Reflective and then diffractive solar sails were first devised in the earliest days of stellar exploration during the 20th-21st centuries, as a way to "sail" through space for long periods without needing to install engines or fuel. Diffractive sails also serve as a solar cell.

Solar Sail (Huge).name: Solar Sail (Huge)
Solar Sail (Huge).description: This is the largest solar sail available in known space. It looks ridiculous on anything smaller than a medium warship, letting you be seen from hundreds of kilometers away, but it does its job. 	If it were not for a series of cameras mounted on various structural parts of this sail, most ships' view would be significantly blocked.

Sailor's Sail.name: Sailor's Sail
Sailor's Sail.description: Wait, did you take this from the Sailor?
